decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot remains tightly anchored in our core automation, formwork and controls knowledge, so our strong internal learning and system-integration capabilities favor continued refinement over withdrawal.

The automatic de-shuttering robot is still close to our established plant-process expertise and installed-base learning, though some functional overlap with broader robotic offerings keeps a moderate residual exit risk.
The automatic shuttering robot fits our long-developed capabilities in precast production automation and benefits from in-house R&D and service feedback, making continuation the more likely course.

As a new product line built on familiar cleaning, plotting and material-handling tasks within precast plants, it leverages our existing engineering knowledge and can be improved across models through customer learning.

The production analysis software is adjacent rather than fully core, but our established controls, planning and lifecycle-support capabilities give us enough absorptive capacity to integrate customer data feedback and develop it further instead of dropping it.
